## 2026

**INEEID Network, online, 20 October 2026** \
Project ArHa: a global record of arenavirus and hantavirus sampling in small mammals. An invited 45-minute talk to the network led by Stephanie Seifert, on how the database was built, what it holds, what has been done with it and where it goes next. \
[Slides](/presentations/2026-ineeid-arha/) · [Project ArHa](/research/arha.html)
